analysis.title: Fluence Energy Inc. (FLNC): First Take: F4Q26 miss amid execution challenges; record bookings as hyperscaler demand builds
key_insights: FLNC reported F4Q26 revenue of about $744mn, below GSe $797mn and FactSet consensus $812mn, on shipment delays tied to the ramp-up of its contract manufacturer's facility.
Non-GAAP gross margin was (3.7)% vs 14.3% in F4Q25 and GS forecast of 9.9%, pressured by liquidated damages on project delays and cost overruns on new product deployment.
F4Q26 adjusted EBITDA of about ($112mn) matched GSe of ($112mn) but was below consensus of ($100mn), down from about $72mn in F4Q25.
F2026 revenue of about $2.3bn and adjusted EBITDA of about ($203mn) were broadly in line with the recently reduced guidance of $2.4bn and about ($200mn).
F2026 revenue absorbed about $90mn of liquidated damages, and EBITDA also reflected about $85mn of new product cost overruns and about $25mn of higher S&M and R&D.
Record quarterly order intake of about $3.5bn, up about 150% from the prior record of about $1.4bn, lifted F2026 orders to about $6.2bn from about $2.9bn in F2025.
Backlog hit a record $8.9bn from $6.4bn last quarter. F4Q26 included about $586mn of hyperscaler orders and data centers were about 10% of FY26 backlog.
Contracted backlog as of 9/30/2026: Energy Storage 16.8GW, Services 10.1GW, Digital 10.9GW, vs 12.6GW/7.9GW/13.9GW at 6/30/2026.
GS rates FLNC Neutral with a 12-month price target of $7.00 vs $3.80 price (84.2% implied upside), based 50% on DCF and 50% on 0.4x FY2027E EV/Sales ($8.00).
Management call is at 8:30 a.m. ET on 11/24. GS target history shows steady cuts from $22 in May 2026 to $7.00 on 3-Nov-26.

market_movers.rationale: Revenue and margin miss on execution issues offset record bookings and hyperscaler demand. Price target unchanged at $7.00 in this first take.
